怎么登录和绑定？: How do I sign in and link my accounts?
选择战队所在的 Discord 或 KOOK 平台，确认授权。首次进入会引导你前: Choose your clan's Discord or KOOK platform and authorize access. On your first visit, verify your account on Steam, then return to your wipe event. No manual ID entry is needed.
请在开始登录的同一个浏览器继续。授权已过期可以重新开始；遇到账号关联冲突，请联系: Continue in the browser where you started signing in. Restart if authorization has expired. For an account-link conflict, ask a clan administrator to check the existing links. Signing in again will not overwrite your profile.
怎样修改报名？: How do I change my sign-up?
打开开荒详情，选择“修改报名”。准时、晚些到或这次不来，都需要保存。晚到要填写完: Open the wipe event and select “Edit sign-up”. Save your choice whether you are on time, late, or not attending. For late arrivals, enter the full date and time and check the time zone. Withdrawing returns your status to “No response”; “Not attending” is an explicit response.
时间变了，或者提交结果不明确？: What if times change or a submission is uncertain?
安排或回复变化后，请对比原确认和最新安排，再明确确认保存。网络断开或超时后，先查: Compare the previous confirmation with the latest arrangements, then confirm and save. After a disconnect or timeout, check the original operation first. A missing result does not mean it failed; retry the same request. Do not submit a separate sign-up until it is verified.
游戏战绩需要各数据来源完成同步。暂无数据与零击杀不同，页面会保留待同步说明。采集: Stats update after their sources finish syncing. Missing data is different from zero kills and is marked as awaiting sync. Collection failures do not prevent verified members from viewing events or signing up.
怎样进入游戏？: How do I join the server?
在开荒详情的“服务器”页面查看地址。若管理员提供了连接命令，可以复制到 Rust: Find the address on the wipe event's Server tab. If a connection command is available, copy it into the Rust console. Join according to the expected wipe time and your sign-up.

到“我的队伍”查看所属队伍，再通过战队原有社区频道联系队长。报名截止后的临时调整: Check your squad under “My squad”, then contact its leader through your clan's community channels. Changes after sign-up closes require a leader with the appropriate permissions.
